UserNode.title: UserNode
UserNode.description: Zero-knowledge user identity node storing public cryptographic key fingerprint and blind routing metadata.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this node.

phoneHash.description: SHA-256 blinded hash of verified phone number for zero-knowledge contact discovery.

publicKeyHex.description: Public X25519 + Ed25519 identity key encoded in hex.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of node registration via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

EncryptedEnvelope.title: EncryptedEnvelope
EncryptedEnvelope.description: Zero-knowledge E2EE message envelope stored in user's cloud relay vault. Server and database see only opaque ciphertext.

userId.description: Owner UID of the vault storing this envelope.

conversationId.description: Target conversation, group, or channel identifier.

senderHandle.description: Blinded or public handle of sender.

cipherSuite.description: Cipher suite identifier used to seal the payload (e.g. AEGIS-52).

nonceHex.description: 96-bit / 192-bit cascade AEAD initialization vector in hex.

ciphertextHex.description: Dual-layer encrypted and padded payload in hex.

macTagHex.description: Poly1305 + GCM + SHA3-512 integrity authentication tag.

transportRoute.description: Transport route over which the envelope was dispatched.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user zero-knowledge identity node and blind relay configuration.
